key_features.classic_presentation: ONSET: SUDDEN onset. LOCATION: UNILATERAL chest pain (left or right). DURATION: Continuous until treated. CHARACTER: SHARP, PLEURITIC (worse with breathing). AGGRAVATING: Deep inspiration, cough. RELIEVING: Shallow breathing, sitting upright. TIMING: Sudden onset, persistent. SEVERITY: 7-10/10 for pain and dyspnea. KEY POSITIVES: Tall, thin young male (spontaneous), recent trauma or procedure, decreased breath sounds on affected side, hyperresonance, dyspnea. KEY NEGATIVES: NOT bilateral, NOT gradual onset, NOT cardiac radiation pattern.

red_flags: Recent trauma or central line placement
Absent breath sounds on one side
